name: jarvis-cargo-builder
description: Bounded Rust Cargo project builder for JARVIS-generated development workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Build and test Rust projects through Cargo.
interface.longDescription: Inspects a Rust project and runs bounded check, test, build, format, and lint workflows without system mutation.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $cargo-builder for a bounded Cargo workflow. Inspect Cargo.toml and toolchain evidence before building.
